title: AgentMesh Agent Manifest (DRAFT)
description: PROPOSED schema describing an AgentMesh agent's identity, capabilities, and endpoints. This is a draft for Phase 1 discussion; nothing here is finalized or implemented.

agent_id.description: Stable, unique identifier for the agent within a mesh. Format intentionally left open (e.g., a URN or URL) pending mesh-scoping decisions.

description.description: Optional human-readable summary of what the agent does.

version.description: The agent's own release version (semver string recommended).

capabilities.description: The kinds of tasks this agent can accept. Capability matching semantics are an open design question.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this capability.

input_hint.description: Optional hint describing the context shape the agent expects. Whether this should reference a JSON Schema is an open question.

output_hint.description: Optional hint describing the result shape the agent produces.

endpoints.description: Where callers should interact with this agent.

base_url.description: Root URL of the agent's API.

manifest.description: Full URL of the manifest endpoint. Defaults to base_url + /manifest.

tasks.description: Full URL for task submission. Exact path is a Phase 2 decision.

webhook_callback.description: Optional URL where asynchronous task notifications should be delivered (Phase 4).

metadata.description: Optional extension point for vendor or deployment metadata. Consumers must ignore unknown entries.
